name: su-fenjingskill
title: 导演分镜 v3.1.1
job_to_be_done: 把完整剧本或锁定场景转换为按题材机制和导演方法组织的可拍、可剪六列文字分镜。

trigger_surface.description: 将中文或多语言完整剧本、连续场景、锁定片段或概念材料转换为导演与摄影师视角的六列文字分镜和 director-shot-data/3.1.0。先完整理解剧本，再按逐场题材机制与指定或确认的导演方法设计时间、视点、调度、摄影、声音和剪辑；逐字保护中文对白、标点、称谓与语气，不生成图片、视频 Prompt、视频或下游 Cut 分组。
should_trigger: 完整理解这部剧本，再按导演和摄影师视角做六列文字分镜。
同一场戏按两种导演方法给出真正不同的剪辑方案。
先判断这场喜剧靠什么节拍工作，再设计镜头和反应。
把动作场面按目标、方向和因果拆成可拍分镜。
按是枝裕和的反应余波方法设计这段家庭对白分镜。
把这两个连续场景做成固定四文件导演交付。
Design a director and cinematographer storyboard using scene mechanism and a confirmed director method.
Create motivated shot topology, sound relations, blocking, and a six-column production storyboard.
should_not_trigger: 把已有分镜编译成 Seedance 视频 Prompt。
根据 shot_data 生成九宫格分镜图。
只比较两个导演的风格，不做分镜。
编辑已生成的分镜图片。
edge_cases: 用户只说电影感但未指定方法时，应进入最多两个方法方案的 Gate 1。
用户指定导演但要求复制某部电影具体镜头时，编译可泛化方法并拒绝逐镜复刻。
用户给概念梗概时可做 concept board，但不得声称逐字来源完整。
中文来源中的角色标签、括号表演说明、全角标点和实际口播必须分离并逐字保护。

steps: Lock source truth and reverse-audit source units without creating cuts.
Identify one primary and at most one secondary scene mechanism.
Compile or confirm an executable director method.
Resolve mechanism and method into a scene strategy.
Confirm mandatory Gate 2 shot topology and edit relations.
Execute cinematography, blocking, performance, sound, duration, and continuity.
Adapt to the director-shot-data/3.1.0 four-file delivery with Chinese-context checks and production risks outside remarks.
decision_points: Skip stopping at Gate 1 only for an explicit, unambiguous user-specified method.
Never use a source line, speaker change, duration threshold, or minimum-shot principle as the universal boundary generator.
Invalidate review locks only according to source, method, strategy, topology, or execution-text dependency rules.
failure_modes: Different director names produce the same topology with different adjectives.
Genre becomes a label rather than a scene mechanism.
Internal coverage or Gate material leaks into formal delivery.
A formal delivery is claimed without Gate 2 or actual four-file parity.
Chinese speaker labels or performance directions leak into spoken dialogue.
Production risks are written into the six-column remarks field.
